title: (RHBA-2019:0266) Update to Fuse 7.2.0 Images
portal_summary:
This update for the Red Hat Fuse 7.2.0 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Online (Ignite)' images addresses the following Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) issues:
https://www.redhat.com/security/data/cve/CVE-2018-15688.html
https://www.redhat.com/security/data/cve/CVE-2018-16864.html
https://www.redhat.com/security/data/cve/CVE-2018-16865.html
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Online (Ignite) images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.2.0 on OpenShift, see the following section of the Fuse on OpenShift Guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.2/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#patch-images

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.2.0 Online, see the following section of the Integrating Applications with Fuse Online guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.2/html/integrating_applications_with_fuse_online/how-to-install-on-ocp_ug#upgrade-on-ocp_ocp
